question.text: A prospective LP wants the Manager of Kalindi AIF to explain how valuation deviations will be treated under SEBI rules. Per Annexure 12.1 / Ch 12, which SEBI circular governs the standardised valuation approach in AIFs?

answer.text: SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD/CIR/2023/97 dated June 21, 2023.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Ch 12 footnote 128 explicitly cites 'SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/AFD/PoD/CIR/2023/97 dated June 21, 2023' as the standardised valuation approach for AIFs. Deviations/changes must be reported per this circular. **The Trap:** A, B, D are other SEBI regulations unrelated to AIF valuation standardisation. **Cross-Exam Context:** Valuation policy is a major DD and ODD topic. Same SEBI valuation circular is tested in distributor exams (XIX-A/B) but XIX-C Managers must know the circular number for DDQ responses. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Maintain a 'Valuation Policy & Deviations Log' — each time you deviate from IPEV guidelines or the SEBI circular, record the board/valuation committee minute number. Saves hours during ODD.
